sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption evaluated the Department for Correctional Services to identify ways to reduce corruption and other integrity risks.
sentences.support:
The purpose of this evaluation is to identify 
opportunities to minimise the risks of corruption, misconduct and maladministration 
within the Department.

sentences.text: The evaluation concentrated on prisons and examined organisational culture, reporting, policies, recruitment, training and performance management.
sentences.support:
The evaluation has focused primarily on the corruption and integrity risks inherent 
in prison environments, together with some aspects of departmental practice.

sentences.text: The Commissioner considered the Department’s policies and procedures sound but identified improvements to their management, recruitment, training and performance expectations.
sentences.support:
I have identified some further opportunities for enhancing recruitment and training 
processes, together with strengthening expectations in respect of performance 
management.

sentences.text: The Commissioner made 24 recommendations covering staff training, policy controls, prisoner interactions, prison security and performance management.
sentences.support:
In all I have made 24 recommendations. I am pleased that the Chief Executive of the 
Department has indicated

findings.quote:
Introduce regular and mandatory training about grooming and inappropriate 
relationships for all staff who have regular contact with prisoners.

Reinforce the need for absolute compliance with access control screening 
procedures for all persons entering a prison, including staff.
